tasks.title: Search by title or artist
tasks.description:
Make the search box (`#search` in `src/Toolbar.jsx`) narrow the stock list.

- Keep the text in state in `App` and make the input a controlled input: its `value` comes from that state and its `onChange` updates it.
- Show only the records whose `title` or `artist` contains the text, ignoring upper and lower case and the spaces around the text. An empty box shows every record.
- The `Clear` button empties the box and shows every record again.

The check types into the box on a stock it picks and reads the titles of the cards.
nextSteps: Add a state for the search text in `App`.
Pass the text and a way to change it to `Toolbar` as props.
Work out the visible records in `App` and give those to `StockList`.
hints: The toolbar and the list both need the search text, so it has to live in the component that holds both of them.
In `onChange`, `event.target.value` is what the box would show next. Hand it to the setter.
If Clear brings the list back but the box still shows text, the input is not reading `value` from state. Turn both sides to lower case and `trim` the text before you compare.

tasks.title: Pick a genre
tasks.description:
Make the genre select (`#genre`) work.

- Its first option stays `All genres` with the value `all`. After it comes one option per genre found in the stock, each genre once, sorted A to Z, with the genre name as both value and text.
- Keep the picked genre in state in `App` and make the select controlled (`value` and `onChange`).
- A record is shown when it passes both the genre and the search.
- `Clear` also puts the select back to `all`.

The check uses a stock with genres your code has never seen.
nextSteps: Work out the list of genres from the stock in `App`.
Pass it to `Toolbar` and render one option per genre.
Add a state for the picked genre and wire the select.
Add the genre test to the visible records, and reset it in `Clear`.
hints: Any list you can work out from the stock should be worked out, not typed in. The check uses a different stock.
A `Set` keeps each value once, and spreading it back into an array lets you `sort` it.
The filter now asks two questions per record: is the genre `all` or equal to the record's genre, and does the text match.
